title:
The {@link DocumentationSearcher} needs the full-text search index built for documentation for each root package.
This includes documentation extracted from types and topics in that package and all packages it depends on.

Search indexes are built for a particular package, but may be used for other packages that depend on that package
to provide base documentation. For example, an index for the "platform" package is usable in any package
(although it will of course only have documentation for platform types).

Thus there is a distinction between the "used" and "installed" index. An installed index is associated with a
particular root package, but a package which does not have an installed index may use one from one of the packages
it depends on, "platform" for example.

For published packages, the search index is prebuilt during packaging so they always have an _installed_ index.
However packages under development will often have no installed index and will _use_ an index from one of their
dependent packages. A package's index can be explicitly rebuilt using the DocumentationSearcher#build method, which
will construct a fresh search index based on the current state of the package's types and install it.
